findings.input: receipt selection followed by offline upload or response loss
findings.mission: retain input and retry the same logical confirmation
findings.expected: scoped draft survives and the confirmation key stays stable
findings.actual: the screen persisted nothing before upload and generated a new key per press
findings.rootCause: receipt flow bypassed scoped local storage
findings.fix: added one-draft-per-user-household storage, corrupt quarantine, logout purge, manual retry, stable confirmation key, and cancellation of the pending save before successful-draft deletion
findings.regressionTest: offline-draft.test.ts: 30x response-loss retries plus current-source mobile suite
findings.residualRisk: native document picker lifecycle remains RUNTIME_ONLY

findings.residualRisk: response pagination remains a future scale enhancement

findings.input: nine Admin browser scenarios with many independent role fixtures
findings.mission: qualify every workflow in one bounded run
findings.expected: functional failures are distinguishable from harness limits
findings.actual: the final MFA request received 429 and surfaced only as a page-heading timeout
findings.rootCause: the localhost harness inherited the production 30-auth-request budget while intentionally creating many role sessions
findings.fix: added a finite test-only auth budget with environment restoration and explicit MFA response assertion
findings.residualRisk: production rate-limit behavior remains covered separately by security-middleware.e2e.test.ts
